name: Cross-Channel Persistent Incident History & Sanitized Reporting

capabilities.persistence: Thread-safe local SharedPreferences store (capped at 100 entries)
capabilities.redaction: Automatic 4-8 digit OTP/PIN masking with asterisks (******)
capabilities.privacyToggle: User-controlled toggle to completely omit raw message/URL content
capabilities.lifecycle: Supports single-record removal and bulk history wipe
capabilities.reporting: Sanitized text export formatted for official reporting (National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in)
